grammar_errors.mistake: Talking about yesterday he used present مش + adjective; Amal recast with past كان negated by ما.
متحمس takes لـ (sheet: 'متحمس لَ'); right after she said إلهم at 09:00 he said إنهم and she recast إلهم.
'I brought' is جبت; he used the she-form جابت and repeated it at 09:29 and 09:42 despite the recast.
grammar_errors.said: It would be جابت؟ بجيب، جابت.

grammar_errors.mistake: 11+ takes a singular noun; she recast سجادة.
Right after her 09:58 fix he said سجاد again; she recast سجادة a second time.
grammar_errors.fix: يعني بعت أكتر من عشرين سجادة.

grammar_errors.mistake: He used a singular form for 'they didn't buy'; Amal prompted 'they are a group' and he fixed to شطارو (اشتروا).
grammar_errors.fix: ما؟ They are a group so they didn't. ... ستروا. Yes.

grammar_errors.mistake: He joined 'meeting' to 'last week' with no preposition; Amal supplied من.
grammar_errors.fix: So from last week ... So we say من الأسبوع الماضي.

grammar_errors.mistake: Subject is هي; he used the I-form شفت, Amal recast شافت.
grammar_errors.said: هي كانت متحمسة كتير لما شفت السجادة.

grammar_errors.mistake: 'Showed her' needs the object ending on the verb; Amal recast فرجته and confirmed فرجتها.
After هدول the noun keeps el-; Amal prompted and he said هدول الفساتين الغاليين -> صح.
grammar_errors.said: هدول فساتين، الصغار الـ، الـ غاليين.
grammar_errors.fix: Where do I put the L? Those expensive dresses.

grammar_errors.mistake: Target was plural 'long trips'; Amal repeated 'Long trips' and he pluralised.
'This family' is singular feminine هادي; he said هدول, Amal repeated 'This family', he fixed.
Indefinite 'a big table' takes no el- on the adjective; Amal asked 'Do I need L here?'.
grammar_errors.fix: There's a big table. ... Do I need L here?

grammar_errors.mistake: باب is masculine; Amal repeated مفتوح and he fixed ('cause it's bab').
First word of idafa never takes el-: باب الغرفة المفتوح.
grammar_errors.said: So el ba-- No. Yeah, el bab.

grammar_errors.mistake: In the idafa drill she prompted the el- placement; he moved to dars al-arabi; she explained both readings.
grammar_errors.fix: Where do I put the ال؟ ... the Arabic lesson of Arabic is درس العربي.

grammar_errors.mistake: Noun + adjective both take el-; he put it only on the adjective like idafa; Amal said no.
grammar_errors.said: walad al, uh, ayan. / So walad al ayan now, the sick boy.
grammar_errors.fix: So where, where do I put the ال؟ ... No. ... It's not boy the sick. It's the sick boy.

grammar_errors.mistake: No b- after لازم; Amal repeated لازم and he fixed to يدل.
Stay IN his home needs في; Amal prompted 'In his home', he fixed.
ولد is masculine so the adjective stays عيان; she told him the -a form is for a girl.
grammar_errors.said: الـ ولاد الـ أيان، نه، أيانة، right?

grammar_errors.mistake: Feminine first word of idafa grows -t; she prompted 'what do we add?' and he answered 'the T'.
grammar_errors.fix: So for feminine nouns, what do we add?

grammar_errors.mistake: 'The apple tree' is idafa (شجرة التفاح, first word no el-); he built noun+adjective with el- on both.
grammar_errors.fix: the apple tree. I'm not describing the tree. I'm saying it's the tree of apples.

grammar_errors.mistake: Feminine كندرة grows -t before the owner; she said 'Kundera-t because...'. Engine writes his repeat as kundara, so whether he fixed it is unclear.
grammar_errors.said: el kunda-- or kundara el Chanel.

grammar_errors.mistake: 'Are here' needs no verb; فيه means 'there is'; Amal said no, just هون.

grammar_errors.fix: ليش فيه هون؟ ... No, they're just هون. طلاب الجامعة هون.

grammar_errors.mistake: شنتة سفر is idafa so el- goes on the second word, not شنتة; Amal asked why he put ال and moved هذه after.
grammar_errors.fix: So why did you put ال؟ هذه. ... يعني شنتة السفر هذه إلي.
